title: POPANE-P0b Study 6 outcome-blind true-header discovery
reason_for_revision: P0 verified range access and ZIP structure but treated the first metadata comment line as the CSV header. P0b corrects only that parser assumption; it remains outcome-blind.
allowed_reads: ZIP filenames and sizes already permitted by P0
For deterministic sampled CSV entries, read sequential text lines only until the first non-empty line that does not start with '#'; record that line as the column header and stop immediately.
Record preceding '#' metadata field names/text because these are file-format metadata, not observations.
forbidden: Do not read the first data row after the header.
Do not inspect valence or physiology values.
Do not change participant/stimulus inclusion using outcomes.
deterministic_sample: Lexicographically sort CSV paths; exclude *_All.csv and *_Baseline.csv; inspect first 18 remaining entries, plus first 3 baseline entries. Scan at most 64 text lines per file to find the true header.
qc: verify at least ECG and EDA or other peripheral channels
record metadata keys available before header
infer participant and stimulus labels from filenames only
count distinct participant IDs and stimulus-label families from all archive filenames

decisions.PASS_REMOTE_REPLICATION_FEASIBLE: True headers establish synchronized valence + time/index + >=2 peripheral channels, with participant IDs and multiple independently named stimulus/emotion segments.
decisions.PASS_PERSON_ONLY_GENERALIZATION: Synchronized valence+physiology exists but stimulus/segment identity is unusable for held-out-stimulus evaluation.
decisions.FAIL_SCHEMA: Required synchronized columns are absent or true header cannot be found.

firewall: Schema-only correction following P0 parser failure. No scientific outcome is inspected.
